exams.notes: Written examination required for each classification; may be waived under certain conditions per Section 7065.1 and 7065.2.

available.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state

requirements.value: Reciprocal licensure available if the other state accepts CA qualifications and the board ascertains that professional qualifications and conditions of good standing are at least the same or greater in that state as in California. Trade examination may be waived if applicant provides written certification of good standing for the previous five years.
requirements.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state, and if the board ascertains, on a case-by-case basis, that the professional qualifications and conditions of good standing for licensure and continued licensure are at least the same or greater in that state as in California.

credential_type.quote: Contractors' licenses are to be issued to individual owners, partnerships, corporations, limited liability companies, and participating tribes, in accordance with this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: it is a misdemeanor for a person to engage in the business of, or act in the capacity of, a contractor within this state

title_protection.quote: It is a misdemeanor for any person to advertise for construction or work of improvement covered by this chapter unless that person holds a valid license under this chapter in the classification so advertised

disciplinary_grounds.description: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Abandonment without legal excuse of any construction project or operation engaged in or undertaken by the licensee as a contractor constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion of funds received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion of funds or property received for prosecution or completion of a specific construction project or operation...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful departure in any material respect from accepted trade standards for good and workmanlike construction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A willful departure in any material respect from accepted trade standards for good and workmanlike construction constitutes a cause for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the state or any political subdivision.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willful or deliberate disregard and violation of the building laws of the state, or of any political subdivision thereof...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action against a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to make and keep records showing all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to make and keep records showing all contracts, documents, records, receipts, and disbursements by a licensee of all of his or her transactions as a contractor...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Omission or misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or licensee in obtaining or renewing a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Omission or misrepresentation of a material fact by an applicant or a licensee in obtaining, or renewing a license, or in adding a classification to an existing license constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in a material respect to complete any construction project for the price stated in the contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in a material respect on the part of a licensee to complete any construction project or operation for the price stated in the contract...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter or allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or abetting an unlicensed person to evade the provisions of this chapter or combining or conspiring with an unlicensed person, or allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter or any rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure in any material respect to comply with the provisions of this chapter, or any rule or regulation adopted pursuant to this chapter...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Doing any willful or fraudulent act as a contractor in consequence of which another is substantially injured.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The doing of any wilful or fraudulent act by the licensee as a contractor in consequence of which another is substantially injured constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting in the capacity of a contractor except in the name of the licensee as set forth upon the license or in accordance with the personnel of the licensee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting in the capacity of a contractor under any license issued hereunder except: (a) in the name of the licensee as set forth upon the license, or (b) in accordance with the personnel of the licensee...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Entering into a contract with a contractor while such contractor is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Entering into a contract with a contractor while such contractor is not licensed as provided in this chapter constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful failure or refusal without legal excuse to prosecute a construction project with reasonable diligence causing material injury.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful failure or refusal without legal excuse on the part of a licensee as a contractor to prosecute a construction project or operation with reasonable diligence causing material injury to another constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willful or deliberate failure to pay any moneys when due for materials or services rendered in connection with operations as a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilful or deliberate failure by any licensee or agent or officer thereof, to pay any moneys, when due for any materials or services rendered in connection with his operations as a contractor...constitutes a cause for disciplinary action

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions, and duties of a contractor.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A conviction of a crime substantially related to the qualifications, functions and duties of a contractor constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of safety provisions resulting in death or serious injury to an employee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any safety provision in, or authorized by, Division 5 (commencing with Section 6300) of the Labor Code resulting in death or serious injury to an employee constitutes a cause for disciplinary action.

bonding_required.quote: The board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee file or have on file a contractor's bond in the sum of twenty-five thousand dollars ($25,000).

insurance_required.quote: the board shall require as a condition precedent to the issuance, reinstatement, reactivation, renewal, or continued maintenance of a license, that the applicant or licensee have on file at all times a current and valid Certificate of Workers' Compensation Insurance or Certification of Self-Insurance

definition_quote.value: A specialty contractor is a contractor whose operations involve the performance of construction work requiring special skill and whose principal contracting business involves the use of specialized building trades or crafts.
definition_quote.quote: A specialty contractor is a contractor whose operations involve the performance of construction work requiring special skill and whose principal contracting business involves the use of specialized building trades or crafts.

license_tiers.quote: the contracting business includes any or all of the following branches: (a) General engineering contracting. (b) (1) General building contracting. (2) Residential remodeling contracting. (c) Specialty contracting.

scope_exclusions.quote: This chapter does not apply to any construction or operation incidental to the construction and repair of irrigation and drainage ditches...This chapter does not apply to any person who only furnishes materials or supplies without fabricating them into, or consuming them in the performance of, the work of the contractor.

qualifier_required.quote: "Qualifying person," "qualifying individual," or "qualifier," as used in this chapter, means a person who qualifies for a license pursuant to Section 7068.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: the licensee or the qualifier shall notify the registrar in writing within 90 days after the date of disassociation. The licensee shall have 90 days after the date of disassociation in which to replace the qualifier.

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: The licensee shall have 90 days after the date of disassociation in which to replace the qualifier. Upon failure to replace the qualifier within 90 days after the date of disassociation, the license shall be automatically suspended or the classification removed at the end of the 90 days.

expedited_licensure_pathway_available.quote: The registrar may accept the qualifications of an applicant who is licensed as a contractor in a similar classification in another state if that state accepts the qualifications of a contractor licensed in this state for purposes of licensure in that other state

small_project_dollar_threshold_exemption.quote: This chapter does not apply to a work or operation on one undertaking or project by one or more contracts if the aggregate contract price for labor, materials, and all other items is less than one thousand dollars ($1,000)

utility_worker_exemption.quote: This chapter does not apply to public utilities operating under the regulation of the Public Utilities Commission on construction, maintenance, and development work incidental to their own business
